prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Extreme wide shot. A giant long rectangular wooden crate of rough planks smeared pitch-black, with a flat plank roof and flat square ends, as tall at both ends as in the middle rests level on the bare top of a mountain, the roof empty and flat, morning light breaking through parting clouds over still flood water below and mist lifting off the slopes. Dawn, golden light after rain. Hushed and hopeful. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No people, no text, no logos.
